inheritance.comparator: the newest earlier catalog YAML naming the product's repository (Q-CPP-2's newest accepted packet; the verifier's newest_accepted), by first slot
inheritance.firstSlotReading: a YAML's first slot is the first layer whose catalog (its authority's baselinePackets | {authorityPacket} | productPackets) holds it; the earliest layer's baseline is the base, older than every slot
inheritance.predicate: every comparator argv byte-exact and in order, insertions allowed (the verifier's require_inherits)

pin.rule: {product id: {packet, sha256}} for every listed product with a comparator, in PRODUCT_PACKETS order; the pinned packet is the comparator and its sha256 is its baselinePackets digest

inheritance.predecessorRule: when the product's predecessors field is non-empty, its newest predecessor by first slot equals the comparator; none present, or a tie, refuses
steps: 1 every YAML in the slot's catalog view has a readable repository line (else refuse)
2 the candidates: earlier YAMLs naming the repository; none means a first packet, with no pin
3 one YAML in the candidates' newest first slot (else ambiguous comparator; the base too)
4 the pin, in order: missing, foreign, stale, digest
inheritance.knownLimit: a repository whose newest earlier YAML ties in the base refuses (ambiguous comparator) until a pinned base order is ruled (Q278-5)
